obligations.note: The approved catalog bounds mortgage.privileged_idle_minutes to <= 15, but the change sets Policy.PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES and controls/mortgage/policy-params.json to 20. The SES-1 control test passes only because it compares the code against the edited params file, not the catalog bound of 15.

The SES-1 deviation needs a valid exception and none exists. The only SES-1 exception, EXC-0141, is scoped to payments.session, not a mortgage component, and it expired on 2026-09-16, before the review time of 2026-10-16.

Ticket CHG-24534 was approved by change manager erik.brandt on 2026-10-08, before the PR opened. Its components (mortgage.policy, mortgage.tests, mortgage.controls-data) cover all three touched paths.
wen.li has the change_approver role for baseline-mortgage, is not the author priya.raman under any of her addresses, and gave a code_review approval.
Both approvals name the head commit 8eacf77, which is the change's only commit.

The CI run on head 8eacf77 succeeded: 124 tests, 0 failures, 0 skipped. That includes the registered SES-1 control test, controls.SessionControlTest#privilegedIdleTimeoutWithinPolicy (labelled exhaustive). The test still can't show compliance, because it reads the threshold from the file this change edited.

The touched components are mortgage.policy, mortgage.tests and mortgage.controls-data, none marked security_sensitive. Session.java and SessionStore.java are not modified, so no security_review approval is required.
The change edits protected path controls/mortgage/policy-params.json. rachel.stein (control_owner, controls-office, outside the author's lending-eng team) approved the head commit.
Ticket type is standard and the change is not marked emergency, so no post-implementation review is required.

Ledger entries that cover Policy.java (ACR-0405, ACR-0406) cover UNDERWRITER_LIMIT, SENIOR_LIMIT, DTI_MAX_PERCENT and LTV_MAX_PERCENT, none of which changed. No ledger evidence lapses because of this change.

summary: The change raises the mortgage privileged idle timeout from 15 to 20 minutes and changes the policy-params value to match. The approved catalog bounds SES-1 at 15 minutes, so the change violates SES-1. The control test passes only because it reads its threshold from the file the change edited. No valid exception covers the deviation: EXC-0141 applies to payments and has expired. The process records (ticket, independent approval, control-owner approval, CI on head) are in order, but they can't cure a product-obligation violation, so the change is rejected.
